AxEnumValue.Name: NotChecked
AxEnumValue.Label: @FOSecure:NotChecked
AxEnumValue.HelpText: The content could not be inspected. Treated as allow.

AxEnumValue.Name: Unrecognized
AxEnumValue.Label: @FOSecure:Unrecognized
AxEnumValue.HelpText: The content carries no signature this check recognizes. Treated as allow.

AxEnumValue.Name: Identified
AxEnumValue.Label: @FOSecure:Identified
AxEnumValue.HelpText: The content was identified, but no claimed extension was supplied to compare it against.

AxEnumValue.Name: Match
AxEnumValue.Label: @FOSecure:MatchesTheExtension
AxEnumValue.HelpText: The identified content agrees with the extension the file claims.

AxEnumValue.Name: Mismatch
AxEnumValue.Label: @FOSecure:ContradictsTheExtension
AxEnumValue.HelpText: The identified content contradicts the extension the file claims. The only outcome a caller may reject on.
